newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Taleban detain 31 Pakistani anti-drug personnel.
newsitem.headline: Taleban detain 31 Pakistani anti-drug personnel.

text.p: Afghanistan's Islamic Taleban militia has detained 31 men belonging to Pakistan's anti-narcotics force who chased heroin smugglers across the Afghan border, officials said on Saturday.

They said Pakistani officials were seeking the release of a colonel, two captains and 28 soldiers who crossed the border on Friday after a gunbattle with smugglers near the town of Chagai, about 35 km (22 miles) south of the frontier.
The smugglers escaped, but the Pakistani force was captured by Taleban fighters who took them to the Afghan town of Lashkargarh, 10 km (six miles) inside the border.
Officials said Afghan consular officials in Quetta and the chief of the Anti-Narcotics Force had gone to Lashkargarh to negotiate the release of the Pakistanis.
